# COMBO_02 · Sustained Blood Spray (single rate Base)

## 1. Search Summary (embedding target)

Sustained Blood Spray (single rate Base). An uninterrupted, continuously erupting liquid / blood spray. Representative prompt: "Make an effect where blood and liquid keep bursting continuously". A dark crimson gradient (#5E0000 -> #2B0500) reads as blood. Composition: Base LiquidScatter_R_A / Detail none / Extra none. Duration 0.5s. Related vocabulary: blood, bleed, bleeding, gore, sustained, continuous, spray, spurt, splash, liquid, water, scatter, red, 피, 혈액, 유혈, 출혈, 혈흔, 지속, 계속, 끊임없이, 분출, 뿜다, 뿌리다, 액체, 물, 스프레이, 스플래시, 빨강, 암적색.

## 3. Composition Structure

| Layer | Source | Spawn | Size | Speed | Delay | Color (start -> end) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | LiquidScatter_R_A | rate 21/s x 0.5s | 1 | 1 | 0 | #5E0000 -> #2B0500 |

- Layer usage: Base 1 / Detail 0 / Extra 0 (1 sources total)
- Playback: `AutoActivate` True / `InfiniteLoop` False / `LoopCount` 1
- `LoopDuration` **0.5s** — read-only derived value. Cannot be set directly.
  - Determining factor: The only source, `LiquidScatter_R_A`, gives Delay 0 + Duration 0.5 = **0.5s**. With a lone rate source the derived value matches Duration exactly

## 4. Design Rationale (Why This Combination)

1. The adverb of continuity — "sustained", "continuously" — is the decisive signal for a rate source (the `_R` suffix)
2. A minimal recipe that works with one Base and no Detail or Extra. Single material plus single motion means no extra layers
3. The 0.5s LoopDuration was not authored; it is derived automatically from the lone source Duration of 0.5s. A rate-only recipe is the most direct form of length control

## 5. Applied Composition Patterns

- `single_base_only` — Minimal recipe, single Base
- `rate_spawn_for_sustained` — "Sustained / continuous" wording -> rate (_R) source

## 7. Adaptation Guide (for the Agent)

- Volume is controlled by `SpawnRate` (21/s). Do not confuse it with `SpawnCount` on burst sources
- Length control = adjusting `Duration`. LoopDuration is read-only and follows along (Duration 0.5 -> 1.5 makes LoopDuration 1.5s)
- For water, swap only the Color to #3FA8FF tones; no source change needed
